configuration.change: Correct the old-population color at the warm northern bar edge.

details.normalization: After each color proposal, one scalar preserves l29 total light in the measured outer annulus at radii at least 4 kpc. The actual nonlinear display curve is included. No outskirts gain or density changes.
details.population: The existing Gaia red-giant/red-clump field and individual stellar colors stay fixed. Only its one global RGB display grade changes.
details.diagnosis: F3 has real reddening, but reddening-corrected MCPS light is no redder than nearby light. The old component in the reference model has post-grade R/G about 5 at F3, versus intrinsic MCPS integrated R/G about 1.17. The inherited old-light grade suppresses green and blue. This motivates a global old-material test, but does not prove a unique physical cause: the MCPS aperture mixes populations and its passbands differ from the graded image.

dustTrial.reason: An OGLE positive-residual dust trial barely changes either pin and adds 38.0% to the native dust-column budget. It is not retained.

details.uncertainty: MCPS integrated flux includes unresolved-light estimates and mixed stellar populations; passbands differ from the processed photo. G4 lacks cached bar-table support. The correction is a global appearance grade, not a new measured population age or dust distance.
details.frozen: All density maps, catalogue objects, grain, geometry, dust, bar component grade, young grade, gas grade, stretch and saturation.
